verdict.rationale: incident.io ships built-in Insights dashboards that cover pager load, out-of-hours paging (on-call health) and response time. Configurable week/month/quarter ranges with previous-period comparison let a leader see whether things are improving. Missing for 10: explicit MTTA/MTTR metric definitions, explicit incident-volume/load trend charts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboards.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I get reliability analytics — MTTA/MTTR trends, incident load, on-call health — to see whether we are actually improving

citations.quote: Answer pager load, out-of-hours paging, response time and follow-up questions from the dashboards Insights ships with.
you can choose to include data from the current Week/Month/Quarter... You can also compare with the previous period by toggling it on.
Flag the alerts that waste your time with one click, then find them again in the alerts list and insights.
